summary: Finance of America Companies Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary, Finance of America Reverse LLC, closed the purchase from Onity Mortgage Corporation of a reverse mortgage servicing portfolio (~20,000 HECM loans with $5.2B UPB) plus certain reverse origination assets and a three-year subservicing arrangement. No price/share or premium was disclosed; the deal is already closed as of June 30, 2026. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor was named. The mechanics involve a portfolio and asset purchase with regulatory clearance presumably obtained. Watch for potential integration risks and any impact on FOA's servicing metrics.
